verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the generated app is 'backed by editable code' and that code can be synced to Git, downloaded, or edited locally in an IDE and pushed back, but the evidence never describes an in-app file/code editor panel inside the Lovable builder itself — edits inside the builder are primarily done via chat/agent prompts (Build mode) rather than direct code editing in the UI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an in-builder code/file editor, independent/hands-on confirmation that developers can directly manipulate raw source files without leaving the builder.
